messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Your response must contain a Markdown-style table. If you include a table, use a Markdown table (pipes '|' plus a dashed separator row). Make sure each of these appears in the response: ['25%']. Keep it to 100 words or fewer. (Words are made of English letters; apostrophes inside a word are allowed.) The final line of your response must be exactly: "The essay is very short.".

Write a rubric for rating how good a teenager's essay is. No tables. Avoid table-like formatting. Finish with "The essay is unfinished." and don’t add anything after it. Do not write fewer than 101 words. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) No digits are allowed anywhere in the response.
